textAr: الأجر الأساسي: ما يعطى للعامل مقابل عمله، بموجب عقد عمل مكتوب أو غير مكتوب، مهما كان نوع الأجر ... الأجر الفعلي: الأجر الأساسي مضافا إليه سائر الزيادات المستحقة الأخرى التي تتقرر للعامل ... الاستقالة: إفصاح العامل كتابة عن رغبته دون إكراه في إنهاء عقد عمل محدد المدة دون تعليق على قيد أو شرط، وقبول صاحب العمل بها
textEnUnofficial: Wage: Means the actual wage ... Basic Salary: Everything given to the worker in return for their work, based on a written or unwritten employment contract, regardless of the type of wage or method of payment, in addition to periodic allowances. ... Actual wage: The basic wage plus any other due increments granted to the worker in return for effort exerted in the work, risks faced in performing the job, or as stipulated in the employment contract or work regulations, including the following: ... 2. Allowances that the worker is entitled to receive in exchange for the effort exerted or risks encountered while performing their work.
note: Definitions (excerpt), as amended by M/44. Arabic wage definitions: consolidated HRSD text (2025-11); resignation definition: HRSD 2025-07 PDF (https://www.hrsd.gov.sa/sites/default/files/2025-07/nzam-al-ml----wfq-alhwyt-aljdydt-2.pdf); both rebuilt from PDF text that extracted reversed. English: HRSD translation of the 2025 amendments (https://www.hrsd.gov.sa/sites/default/files/2025-03/Amendments%20to%20Labor%20Law%20Articles.pdf).

textAr: يبطل كل شرط يخالف أحكام هذا النظام، ويبطل كل إبراء أو مصالحة عن الحقوق الناشئة للعامل بموجب هذا النظام ... ما لم يكن أكثر فائدة للعامل
textEnUnofficial: Any condition that conflicts with the provisions of this Law shall be deemed null and void. The same applies to any release or settlement of the worker's rights arising from this Law during the validity of the employment contract, unless the same is more beneficial to the worker.
note: Arabic: consolidated HRSD text (2025-11), partial, rebuilt from reversed PDF text. English: HRSD English edition (https://www.hrsd.gov.sa/sites/default/files/2023-02/Labor.pdf). Not amended in 2025.

textEnUnofficial: The employment contract for a non-Saudi worker must be written and of a fixed term. If the contract does not specify its duration, it is considered to be one year starting from the worker's actual commencement date. If the work continues after this period, it is considered renewed for a similar duration.
note: Applies to non-Saudi workers only. HRSD translation of the 2025 amendments.

textAr: إذا كان العامل خاضعاً للتجربة، وجب النص على ذلك صراحة في عقد العمل، وتحديد مدتها بوضوح، على ألا يزيد مجموع المدة في جميع الأحوال على (مائة وثمانين) يوماً. وتبين اللائحة الأحكام المتصلة بذلك بما في ذلك ما يتعلق بالإجازات التي لا تدخل في حساب المدة.
textEnUnofficial: If the worker is subject to a probationary period, this must be explicitly stated in the employment contract, with the duration specified, provided that the total duration does not exceed one hundred and eighty days in all cases. ... Both parties have the right to terminate the contract during this period.
note: Arabic: HRSD official summary of the amendments. English: HRSD translation of the 2025 amendments (https://www.hrsd.gov.sa/sites/default/files/2025-03/Amendments%20to%20Labor%20Law%20Articles.pdf).

textEnUnofficial: The worker may not be put on probation more than once with one employer. ... [by written agreement, another probationary period is allowed if it is] in another profession or another job, or that it has been for at least six months since the end of the worker's relationship with the employer. ... If the contract is terminated during the probationary period, neither party shall be entitled to compensation, nor shall the worker be entitled to end of service indemnity for this.
note: HRSD Knowledge Centre (page updated 2025-09-02). Bracketed words are an editorial paraphrase of an omitted passage. Not amended in 2025.

textEnUnofficial: A fixed-term employment contract shall terminate upon expiration of its term. If the two parties continue to implement it, the contract shall be deemed to have been renewed for an indefinite period of time, subject to the provisions of Article 37 of this Law for non-Saudi workers.
note: HRSD English edition.

textAr: فإن تعدد التجديد ثلاث مرات متتالية، أو بلغت مدة العقد الأصلي مع مدة التجديد أربع سنوات أيهما أقل واستمر الطرفان في تنفيذه؛ تحوّل العقد إلى عقد غير محدد المدة
textEnUnofficial: If a fixed-term contract contains a clause providing for its renewal for a similar term or a specified term, the contract shall be renewed for the agreed upon period. If the contract is renewed for three consecutive terms, or if the original contract term and the renewal period amount to four years, whichever is less, and the parties continue to implement it, the contract shall become an indefinite term contract.
note: English: HRSD English edition. Arabic: fragment of the consolidated 2025 HRSD text, rebuilt from reversed PDF text.

textEnUnofficial: In all cases where the contract term is renewed for a specific period of time, the contract renewal period shall be deemed an extension of the original term in determining the worker's rights which takes into account the worker's period of service.
note: HRSD English edition.

textAr: إذا كان العقد من أجل القيام بعمل معين، فإنه ينتهي بإنجاز العمل المتفق عليه
textEnUnofficial: If the contract involves performance of a specific work, it shall terminate with the completion of the agreed upon work.
note: English: HRSD English edition. Arabic: consolidated 2025 HRSD text, rebuilt from reversed PDF text.

textAr: لا يجوز لصاحب العمل أن ينقل العامل بغير موافقته – كتابةً – من مكان عمله الأصلي إلى مكان آخر يقتضي تغيير محل إقامته.
textEnUnofficial: The employer may not relocate the worker from his original place of work to another place that requires a change in place of residence without his written consent.
note: English: HRSD English edition. Arabic: secondary mirror (https://saudi.wiki/%D9%86%D8%B5-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85%D8%A7%D8%AF%D8%A9-58-%D9%85%D9%86-%D9%86%D8%B8%D8%A7%D9%85-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B9%D9%85%D9%84-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B3%D8%B9%D9%88%D8%AF%D9%8A/) matching the published Arabic law text; verify against the consolidated HRSD text. Last amended by M/46 (1436H); not amended in 2025.

textAr: لصاحب العمل – في حالات الضرورة التي قد تقتضيها ظروف عارضة ولمدة لا تتجاوز ثلاثين يوماً في السنة – تكليف العامل بعمل في مكان يختلف عن المكان المتفق عليه دون اشتراط موافقته، على أن يتحمل صاحب العمل تكاليف انتقال العامل وإقامته خلال تلك المدة.
textEnUnofficial: Summary: in cases of necessity caused by temporary circumstances, and for no more than 30 days a year, the employer may assign the worker to work in a place other than the agreed one without the worker's consent, and must bear the worker's travel and accommodation costs for that period.
note: Arabic: secondary mirror (https://saudi.wiki/%D9%86%D8%B5-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85%D8%A7%D8%AF%D8%A9-58-%D9%85%D9%86-%D9%86%D8%B8%D8%A7%D9%85-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B9%D9%85%D9%84-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B3%D8%B9%D9%88%D8%AF%D9%8A/); verify against the consolidated HRSD text. English is our own summary, not an official translation.

textEnUnofficial: The employer must refrain from exploiting the worker for forced labor, must not withhold the worker's wages or any part thereof without judicial basis, must treat the workers with due respect
note: Excerpt. HRSD translation of the 2025 amendments.

textEnUnofficial: Undergo, upon the employer's request, the medical examinations required prior to or during employment to ensure that he is free from occupational or communicable diseases.
note: HRSD English edition.

textEnUnofficial: Keep confidential the technical, trade, and industrial secrets of the materials he produces or those to which he directly or indirectly contributes to the production thereof, as well as all trade secrets related to the work or firm, the disclosure of which is likely to cause damage to the employer's interests.
note: HRSD English edition.

textEnUnofficial: ...nor may a worker be fined for a single violation an amount in excess of a five-day wage, and not more than one penalty shall be applied for the same violation. No more than the equivalent of a five-day wage shall be deducted from his wage in one month in the payment of fines...
note: Excerpt (fine caps). HRSD English edition.

textEnUnofficial: The employment contract shall terminate in any of the following cases: ... 2. If the specified term of the contract expires, unless the contract has been explicitly renewed in accordance with the provisions of this Law; in which case, it shall continue until its term.
note: HRSD translation of the 2025 amendments, near-verbatim as retrieved.

textEnUnofficial: The employment contract shall terminate in any of the following cases: ... 3. Based on the will of one of the parties in contracts of indefinite duration, in accordance with Article (75) of this Law.
note: HRSD translation of the 2025 amendments.

textEnUnofficial: The employment contract shall terminate in any of the following cases: ... 3 (Bis). Resignation.
note: Added by M/44. HRSD translation of the 2025 amendments.

textEnUnofficial: The employment contract shall terminate in any of the following cases: ... 7. Cessation of the activity in which the employee is engaged unless otherwise agreed.
note: HRSD translation of the 2025 amendments.

textEnUnofficial: 1. If the contract is of indefinite duration and the salary is paid monthly, either party may terminate it for a legitimate reason, as follows: a. If the termination is initiated by the employee, they must provide written notice to the employer at least thirty (30) days prior to the termination date. b. If the termination is initiated by the employer, they must provide written notice to the employee at least sixty (60) days prior to the termination date. 2. If the contract is of indefinite duration and the salary is not paid monthly, the party terminating the contract based on a legitimate reason, whether the employee or the employer, must provide written notice to the other party at least thirty (30) days before the termination date.
note: HRSD translation of the 2025 amendments; Arabic consolidated text not yet retrieved.

textEnUnofficial: If the party terminating an indefinite term contract fails to observe the notice period specified in accordance with Article 75 of this Law, such party shall be required to pay the other party a compensation equal to the worker's pay for the duration of the notice period, unless the two parties agree on a greater compensation.
note: HRSD English edition.

textAr: ما لم يتضمن العقد تعويضاً محدداً مقابل إنهائه من أحد الطرفين لسبب غير مشروع، يستحق الطرف المتضرر من إنهاء العقد تعويضاً على النحو الآتي: 1. أجر خمسة عشر يوماً عن كل سنة من سنوات خدمة العامل، إذا كان العقد غير محدد المدة. 2. أجر المدة الباقية من العقد إذا كان العقد محدد المدة. 3. يجب ألا يقل التعويض المشار إليه في الفقرتين (1) و(2) من هذه المادة عن أجر العامل لمدة شهرين.
textEnUnofficial: Unless the contract includes specific compensation for the termination by either party for an invalid reason, the party affected by termination shall be entitled to compensation as follows: (1) For indefinite term contracts: an amount equivalent to fifteen-day wage for each year of the worker's employment. (2) For fixed-term contracts: the wage for the remainder of the contract term. (3) The compensation referred to in paragraphs (1) and (2) of this Article shall not be less than the worker's wage for two months.
note: English: HRSD English edition. Arabic: secondary mirror (https://jisr.zendesk.com/hc/ar-sa/articles/16263920967953); verify against the consolidated HRSD text. Not amended in 2025 (absent from HRSD's list of amended articles).

textEnUnofficial: 1. The resignation request is considered accepted if thirty (30) days have passed since its submission without a response from the employer. The employer has the right to postpone the acceptance of the resignation request for a period not exceeding sixty (60) days if the interests of the work require it, and based on a written explanation provided to the employee. The postponement of acceptance must occur before the expiration of the thirty (30) days ... 3. The employee has the right to withdraw the resignation request within a period not exceeding seven days from the date of its submission unless the employer accepts it before the withdrawal. ... 5. The employment contract remains valid during the resignation request period ... 6. An employee whose contract is terminated by resignation is entitled to all rights stipulated under this Law.
note: Added by M/44 (resignation). HRSD translation of the 2025 amendments; excerpt.

textEnUnofficial: An employer may not terminate the contract without giving the worker an award, advance notice, or indemnity except in the following cases...
note: Opening sentence only. HRSD English edition.

textEnUnofficial: A worker may leave his job without notice in any of the following cases...
note: Opening sentence only. HRSD English edition.

textEnUnofficial: If the work assigned to the worker allows him to get acquainted with the employer's clients, the employer may, for the protection of his legitimate interests, require the worker not to compete with him upon termination of the contract. For this condition to be valid, it shall be in writing and specific, in terms of time, place, and type of work. The validity of such condition shall not exceed two years from the date of termination of the relationship between the two parties.
note: HRSD English edition. Not amended in 2025.

textEnUnofficial: If the work assigned to the worker allows him to have access to the employer's business secrets, the employer may, for the protection of his legitimate interests, require the worker not to disclose such secrets upon termination of the contract. For this condition to be valid, it shall be in writing and specific, in terms of time, place, and type of work.
note: HRSD English edition; Arabic not yet retrieved. Not amended in 2025.

textEnUnofficial: As an exception to the provisions of this Law, the employer may file a suit within one year from the date of discovery of the worker's violation of any of his obligations pursuant to this Article.
note: HRSD English edition; Arabic not yet retrieved.

textAr: إذا انتهت علاقة العمل وجب على صاحب العمل أن يدفع إلى العامل مكافأة عن مدة خدمته تحسب على أساس أجر نصف شهر عن كل سنة من السنوات الخمس الأولى، وأجر شهر عن كل سنة من السنوات التالية
textEnUnofficial: Upon the end of the employment relation, the employer shall pay the worker an end-of-service award equivalent to the amount of a half-month wage for each of the first five years and a one-month wage for each of the following years. The end-of-service award shall be calculated on the basis of the last wage and the worker shall be entitled to an end-of-service award for the portions of the year in proportion to the time spent on the job.
note: Arabic: HRSD Labor Relations page (updated 2025-09-07). English: HRSD English edition (https://www.hrsd.gov.sa/sites/default/files/2023-02/Labor.pdf).

textAr: إذا كان انتهاء علاقة العمل بسبب استقالة العامل يستحق في هذه الحالة ثلث المكافأة بعد خدمة لا تقل مدتها عن سنتين متتاليتين
textEnUnofficial: If the employment relation ends due to the worker's resignation, he shall, in this case, be entitled to one third of the award after service of not less than two consecutive years and not more than five years, to two thirds if his service is in excess of five consecutive years but less than 10 years, and to the full award if his service amounts to 10 years or more.
note: Arabic (opening only): HRSD Labor Relations page. English: HRSD English edition (https://www.hrsd.gov.sa/sites/default/files/2023-02/Labor.pdf).

textEnUnofficial: As an exception to the provisions of Article 8 of this Law, it may be agreed that the wage used as a basis for calculating the end-of-service award does not include all or some of the commissions, sales percentages, and similar wage components paid to the worker which are by their nature subject to increase or decrease.
note: HRSD English edition.

textAr: إذا انتهت خدمة العامل وجب على صاحب العمل دفع أجره وتصفية حقوقه خلال أسبوع - على الأكثر - من تاريخ انتهاء العلاقة العقدية
textEnUnofficial: Summary: when the worker's service ends, the employer must pay the wage and settle the worker's dues within one week at most from the end of the contract. If the worker ended the contract, the employer must settle the dues within two weeks at most.
note: Arabic (first sentence): HRSD Labor Relations page. English is our own summary of the whole article, not an official translation.

textEnUnofficial: No amount shall be deducted from a worker's wages against private rights without his written consent, except in the following cases: ... [5] Fines imposed on the worker on account of violations he commits, as well as deductions made for damages he causes.
note: Opening and item 5 only. HRSD English edition.

textEnUnofficial: In all cases, deductions made may not exceed half the worker's due wage, unless the labor court determines that further deductions can be made or that the worker is in need of more than half his wage.
note: HRSD English edition.

textAr: لا يجوز تشغيل العامل تشغيلاً فعلياً أكثر من ثماني ساعات في اليوم الواحد ... ست ساعات في اليوم، أو ست وثلاثين ساعة في الأسبوع
textEnUnofficial: A worker may not actually work for more than eight hours a day if the employer uses the daily work criterion, or more than forty-eight hours a week if he uses the weekly criterion. During the month of Ramadan, the actual working hours for Muslims shall be reduced to a maximum of six hours a day or thirty-six hours a week.
note: English: HRSD English translation. Arabic: excerpt as quoted by the Saudi Press Agency (https://www.spa.gov.sa/485319).

textEnUnofficial: The weekly rest day shall be at full pay and shall not be less than twenty-four consecutive hours.
note: HRSD English translation of the 2005 text; current wording not checked.

textAr: يجب على صاحب العمل أن يدفع للعامل أجراً إضافياً عن ساعات العمل الإضافية يوازي أجر الساعة مضافاً إليه (50%) من أجره الأساسي، ويجوز لصاحب العمل بموافقة العامل أن يحتسب للعامل أيام إجازة تعويضية مدفوعة الأجر بدلاً عن الأجر المستحق للعامل لساعات العمل الإضافية.
textEnUnofficial: Summary: the employer must pay the worker for overtime hours an additional wage equal to the hourly wage plus 50% of the basic hourly wage. With the worker's consent, the employer may instead grant paid compensatory leave days for the overtime hours.
note: Arabic: HRSD official summary of the 2025 amendments. English is our own summary.

textAr: يستحق العامل عن كل عام إجازة سنوية لا تقل مدتها عن واحد وعشرين يوماً، تُزاد إلى مدة لا تقل عن ثلاثين يوماً إذا أمضى العامل في خدمة صاحب العمل خمس سنوات متصلة
textEnUnofficial: A worker shall be entitled to a prepaid annual leave of not less than twenty one days, to be increased to a period of not less than thirty days if the worker spends five consecutive years in the service of the employer.
note: English: HRSD English translation (same wording on the HRSD Knowledge Centre). Arabic: secondary source (https://www.jisr.net/ar/blog/calculating-annual-leave-for-employees); verify against the consolidated HRSD text. Not amended in 2025.

textEnUnofficial: A worker shall enjoy his leave in the year it is due. He may not forgo it or receive cash in lieu during his period of service. The employer may set the dates of such leave according to work requirements or may grant them in rotation to ensure smooth progress of work. The employer shall notify the worker of the date of his leave in sufficient time of not less than thirty days.
note: HRSD English translation.

textEnUnofficial: A worker may, with the employer's approval, postpone his annual leave or days thereof to the following year.
note: HRSD English translation.

textEnUnofficial: An employer may postpone, for a period of not more than ninety days, the worker's leave after the end of the year it is due if required by work conditions. If work conditions require extension of the postponement, the worker's consent must be obtained in writing. Such postponement shall not, however, exceed the end of the year following the year the leave is due.
note: HRSD English translation.

textEnUnofficial: A worker shall be entitled to a wage for the accrued days of the leave if he leaves the work without using such leave. This applies to the period of work for which he has not used his leave. He is also entitled to a leave pay for the parts of the year in proportion to the part he spent at work.
note: HRSD Knowledge Centre 'Annual Leave' page; same wording in the HRSD English translation.

textAr: 1. يجب النص صراحة في عقد العمل على تحديد مدة التجربة المتفق عليها على ألا تتجاوز مدة التجربة 180 يوماً، ويجوز تقسيم مدة التجربة إلى مُدد متعددة، شريطة أن تكون هذه المُدد متصلة، وأن يتم النص على ذلك بوضوح عند إبرام عقد العمل. 2. لا يدخل في حساب مدة التجربة إجازة عيدي الفطر والأضحى، وإجازة اليوم الوطني، وإجازة يوم التأسيس، والإجازة المرضية.
textEnUnofficial: Summary: the probationary period must be stated expressly in the employment contract and may not exceed 180 days. It may be split into several periods only if they are consecutive and this is stated clearly when the contract is signed. Eid al-Fitr and Eid al-Adha holidays, National Day, Foundation Day and sick leave are not counted in the probationary period.
note: Implements Labor Law Art. 53. Arabic paragraphs 1-2 from the 2025 regulations PDF, rebuilt from reversed PDF text. English is our own summary.

textEnUnofficial: Summary: implementing Labor Law Article 58, a clause in the employment contract that allows the employer to transfer the worker to another place of work counts as the worker's written consent to that transfer, including a transfer that requires a change of residence.
note: Summary from test rating #1 (verified by analyst and reviewer); Arabic text not yet retrieved.

textEnUnofficial: Summary: a fixed-term contract runs for the term stated in clause 5.1 and renews automatically for an equal period, unless one party notifies the other through the Qiwa portal, at least the number of days stated in the clause before the end date, that it does not want to renew.
note: Our own summary of the Qiwa unified employment contract template (Annex 5 of the Implementing Regulations), not the template wording.

textEnUnofficial: Summary: notices and correspondence between the parties about the contract, including notice of non-renewal, have legal effect only when made through the services of the Qiwa portal and documented there.
note: Our own summary of the Qiwa unified employment contract template (Annex 5 of the Implementing Regulations), not the template wording.

textEnUnofficial: Summary: the parties may add terms in the Additional Terms clause (Section 15) only if they do not contradict the terms of the contract, the Labor Law and its Implementing Regulations, or the internal work policy approved by HRSD. Additional terms that do are null and void.
note: Our own summary of the Qiwa unified employment contract template (Annex 5 of the Implementing Regulations), not the template wording.

textEnUnofficial: Summary: Arabic is the official language for executing and interpreting the contract. Another language may be used alongside it, but if the texts differ, the Arabic text prevails.
note: Our own summary of the Qiwa unified employment contract template (Annex 5 of the Implementing Regulations), not the template wording.

textEnUnofficial: Summary: the contract type in clause 1 may be changed only with the consent of both parties, through the procedures approved on the Qiwa portal, and only where the change does not conflict with the Labor Law, its Implementing Regulations and related ministerial decisions.
note: Our own summary of the Qiwa unified employment contract template (Annex 5 of the Implementing Regulations), not the template wording.
